svg.text: respirAI: wiring of the puck (XIAO ESP32-S3)
v3: four LEDs behind the printed lung panel. Solid = core build, wire this. Dashed = optional. Pins as in firmware/respirai/config.h and docs/PLAN.md §3. ● = joined.
seen from the top, USB-C up
in the chest piece; 5 wires go through the cable
two LEDs on D7, one resistor EACH (never shared)
AD8232 ECG: OUTPUT → D0, LO+ → D2, 3.3v → 3V3, GND → GND
LO− and SDN unconnected (no pin left)
MAX30102: SDA → D4, SCL → D5, VIN → 3V3, GND → GND, INT unconnected
XIAO D6 (GPIO43) → 100 Ω → LED trachea → GND
XIAO D7 (GPIO44) → 100 Ω → LED left lobe → GND
• Match pins by the name printed on each board.
The order here keeps the wires straight.
• Mic on 3V3 only. 5V destroys the INMP441.
• Every LED has its own resistor. Two LEDs on
• LED long leg (anode) to the resistor; short
• Diffused 3 mm LEDs, not clear ones.
• Start at 100 Ω and look through the printed
panel: 47 Ω brighter, 220 Ω dimmer. Keep D7
• Check battery polarity with a multimeter
before soldering; mark the + wire with tape.
• The switch cuts BAT+, so the battery charges
over USB-C only with the switch ON.
• A short flicker of the trachea LED at power-on
is normal: D6 also carries the boot messages.
• L/R to GND = left channel, as the firmware
• Every ground symbol (three bars) is GND;
